testCases.title: Verify pagination controls are displayed
steps: Navigate to the product listing page with more products than fit on one page.
expectedResults: Pagination controls are displayed on the screen.

testCases.title: Verify clicking a page number updates the product grid
steps: Navigate to the product listing page.
Click on a specific page number in the pagination controls.
expectedResults: The product grid updates to display products corresponding to the selected page.

testCases.title: Verify current page number is highlighted
steps: Navigate to the product listing page.
Click on a different page number in the pagination controls.
expectedResults: The previously selected page number is no longer highlighted.
The newly selected page number is visually highlighted.
